page_title: OSA 2-3 CEL | Osasuna v Celta Vigo 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+5' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+1' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
89' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a change. Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna) replaces Abel Bretones.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Benito (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Lucas Torro can be given a rest.
87' 2 - 3 GOAL - 2:3! Iago Aspas found Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Sergio Herrera off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
87' A yellow card for a tackle by Abel Bretones (Osasuna). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
83' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
82' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Victor Munoz is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Asier Osambela departs the field of play to be replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
82' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

82' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
81' Substitution. Borja Iglesias is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
80' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
79' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is going to take the penalty!
79' Referee Alejandro Hernandez is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Osasuna!
78' Celebrations by Osasuna are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
77' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty for Osasuna!
76' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
75' The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
75' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Ionut Radu makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
75' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Bryan Zaragoza will be replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
74' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) makes a slide tackle, but referee Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
73' The attendance for today's match is 20065.
72' Ruben Garcia goes off the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on.
71' The linesman raises his flag. Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is adjudged offside.
70' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
70' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
69' 2 - 2 Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) scores from the corner kick. The ball slipped through the box to Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) and he slotted it past the goalkeeper.
68' The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
68' Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
66' The game has begun to heat up. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
66' The foul by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
64' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
64' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) executes a long-range free kick. His well-taken effort flies only inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day.
62' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
62' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
61' The substitution is prepared. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Damian Rodriguez.
61' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) replacing Manuel Fernandez.
61' Today's match ends for Mihailo Ristic who will be replaced by Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo).
61' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
60' A spell of possession for Osasuna in an attempt to control the game.
58' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
55' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
53' It must be a yellow card. It is. Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

52' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Hernandez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
50' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul.
49' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is flagged for offside.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Alejandro Hernandez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.

45+1' 2 - 1 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) connects with a cross from Ruben Garcia inside the six-yard box and steers the ball onto the bar and behind the keeper. Poor defending there has resulted in a scoreline change to 2:1.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
45' A pass into the penalty area from Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is intercepted by the defence.
42' Asier Osambela (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Alejandro Hernandez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) and blew his whistle.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ionut Radu into the bottom right corner.
36' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
35' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Alejandro Hernandez ignores the protests.
35' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Hernandez signals a set piece. Penalty awarded! Osasuna will take a penalty kick.
34' 64:36 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
31' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
31' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
30' That was close by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Borja Iglesias finds Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 0:1.
25' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
23' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
22' A pass from Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is intercepted by Ionut Radu and the move breaks down.
19' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!
17' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
15' Fine attempt! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
15' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is able to continue to play.
13' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
13' No change in the score after an effort on goal by Moi Gomez (Osasuna) from a rebound. Good save by the goalkeeper.

10' Ionut Radu makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Victor Munoz (Osasuna) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the left post.
8' That's unlucky! Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
7' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post.
5' Great touch by Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
4' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Flag goes up against Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half has started.
Celta Vigo will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Hernandez.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
